about: Frame counts at 12 fps for cover motions. Single source of truth: motion.sh applies them, lint.mjs checks them. Leads are prime; each target's 7 motions (lead + 6 secondaries) are pairwise coprime. NOTE (2026-11-15): 84 distinct counts do not exist in [24,180] given the existing 60 counts, so slots 0/4 reuse 29 (8 languages) and 31 (4 languages) across languages; lint's page-wide distinctness check will fail for those duplicates when their motions are built, pending a rule decision. Per-language coprimality holds. Same count per slot every week.
